warningSigns: Says the banking details have changed with immediate effect and asks us to use a new address.
Pushes us to pay today or learners' supply will be interrupted.
Tells us not to use the old address and says not to phone because the phones are down.
Sent from a lookalike-looking domain (mzansi-catering-za.example), so check it against the supplier's known details.
No VAT amount is shown, only 'incl. VAT'.
summary: Mzansi Catering emails to say their payment address has changed and asks us to pay USD 20.00 for invoice MC-2611 (PO-1001) today to the new address, without phoning them.
